name: Zhou Yu
class: Mage — Formation Mage / Sustained Damage/Pushing / Early Game

skills.name: Blaze
skills.text: Damage from Basic Attacks and skills apply marks to enemy units and structures. At 4 stacks, targets are slowed and suffer damage over time.

skills.name: Wildfire
skills.text: Invokes a wind domain in the target direction, slowing and knocking back enemies in range. Nearby teammates gain Movement Speed, and his nearby fires will spread in the direction of the wind.

skills.name: Scorching Bolt
skills.text: Creates a fire domain at the target location that deals burning damage to enemies within it. Up to 6 fire domains can exist at a time. Recovers Health over time while in a fire domain. Can stock up to 3 charges of this skill.

skills.name: Flames of War
skills.text: Deals damage to enemies in range. If there's a fire domain in range, any enemies within it will be stunned and take extra damage.

patchHistory.summary: Increased base Movement Speed and Skill 1's late game cooldown.
Increased Skill 2's damage over time and recovery and reduced late game stock time.
